newsitem.title: USA: Ariz.-San Diego 500 KV power line down Thurs, Fri.
newsitem.headline: Ariz.-San Diego 500 KV power line down Thurs, Fri.

text.p: A 500-kilovolt (KV) power line running from the Palo Verde nuclear plant at Wintersburg, Ariz., to the San Diego region was shut today for routine maintenance and will be down again Friday, sources familiar with the line's operation said Thursday.
The line is the only 500-KV connector between Enova Corp's San Diego Gas & Electric Co and out-of-state power supplies, although the utility has many other transmission lines with lower capacities.
The line was being powered up late Thursday afternoon to return to service overnight, but will be taken down again Friday morning for more maintenance, the sources said.
"This is planned maintenance," said one source. "Every year we take it down for two days."

Traders said the outage contributed to the softer tone of Palo Verde spot power prices on Thursday. Next-day Palo Verde was last quoted near $23.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), down from $24.00-25.00 on Wednesday.

But the unplanned outage early Thursday of a 360 MW unit at the San Juan coal-fired power plant in New Mexico was said to slightly tighten the regional market, serving as something of a counterbalance to the line outage.
